he_version: Midrash Tanhuma haKadum veHaYashan, S. Buber, 1885
en_version: Midrash Tanhuma, S. Buber Recension; trans. by John T. Townsend, 1989.
he: אמר ר' יצחק לא היה צריך לכתוב את התורה אלא מהחדש הזה לכם, ולמה כתב מבראשית, להודיע כח גבורתו, שנאמר כח מעשיו הגיד לעמו לתת להם נחלת גוים (תהלים קיא ו).
en: R. Isaac said: It was only necessary to write the Torah from < the words > (in Exod. 12:2): THIS MONTH SHALL BE FOR YOU.28I.e., from where the actual commandments begin. Cf. Mekhilta de Rabbi Ishmael, which does in fact begin here. Why did he write from < the words > (in Gen. 1:1): IN THE BEGINNING? To make known his mighty power. Thus it is stated (in Ps. 111:6): HE HAS DECLARED TO HIS PEOPLE THE POWER OF HIS WORKS IN GIVING THEM THE HERITAGE OF THE GENTILES.
